Help and security

Your data, on your terms

How YojnaMitra protects and handles what you share.

End-to-end encryption

Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest, always.

OTP-gated actions

Login and submission require a one-time code, every time.

Revocable consent

Approve each step yourself, and withdraw access anytime.

Frontend, backend, and database run as separate isolated layers, so a breach in one never exposes the others. All data is encrypted end to end.

It lets YojnaMitra fetch verified documents directly from your DigiLocker vault for instant, tamper-proof auto-fill — nothing is stored beyond what a form needs.

Yes. Every step — document access, auto-fill, and submission — asks for your explicit consent, and you can cancel before final submission.

Yes, it's a free citizen assistance service — there's no charge to check eligibility or file an application.
